[[Awakened Defiler]]s are animated servants serving as [[necromancer]]s in [[Palawa Joko]]'s [[Awakened|undead army]]. They use a combination of hexes to shutdown physical attackers and fuel a moderate damage output through [[Signet of Suffering]].
